title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：nest　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nest 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the keeper ① built the nest that no child in the zoo would have measured, and he said the building was the whole of the season. The ② nest, meaning the home itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; a nest, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ nest in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ nest at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A nest, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the keeper said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the nest was the whole of the matter, meaning the shelter and not the home. The ⑥ nest, meaning the shelter and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; nest, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a home and a shelter. He said the shelter is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ nest had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ nest of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of measuring; nest, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ nest I remember is the home measured in the register, which closed in 1963 and is still measured as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ nest, my mother said in 1965, is the only home that improves by being measured; every nest, she said, is a shelter that has agreed to look like a home. She said the shelter was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 巢；窝（指兽舍里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 巢；窝（指那个巢本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the nest 筑这一个巢
D. n. 巢；窝（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 巢之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的巢之事）
F. n. 巢；窝（指饲养台账里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 巢、安身（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安身（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the nest that no child in the zoo would have measured
The nest, meaning the home itself and not the fence
the nest at the far shed
the nest was the whole of the matter
the nest had become a line in a register
The nest of the whole thing
A nest, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: build the nest 意为“筑这一个巢”，1956 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯测量的一个巢做了一遍。
nest 意为“巢；窝”，指那个巢本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被测量。
nest 意为“巢；窝”，指兽舍里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
nest 意为“巢；窝”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
nest 意为“巢、安身”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个安身就是那件事的全部。
nest 意为“安身”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个巢，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
nest 意为“巢；窝”，指饲养台账里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1961 年这一个成了饲养台账里的一行。
nest 意为“巢之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的巢之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的测量。
nest 意为“巢；窝”，我记得的是饲养台账里测量过的那一个，1963 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一个。
nest 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，巢是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的巢。
